annotations.title: Read how the resume's experience was understood

description: Returns the account's main resume grouped by role: each employer with its title, location, dates and bullets as read from the file's page layout, plus achievements placed under no role and a count of bullets whose extracted-text position disagrees with the layout. status is ready, pending (still being read; call again shortly) or unavailable (no resume, or it could not be read).
name: get_resume_work_history

bulletsOutOfTextOrder.description: How many bullets the resume's extracted text places under a different role than its page layout does, which usually means a two-column file. Zero means none detected.

source.description: `pdf` when read from the uploaded file's layout, `text` when only the extracted text was available (a DOCX, or a file too large to read as pages).

status.description: `ready` carries the grouping. `pending` and `unavailable` carry empty lists.

unattributed.description: Achievements the resume lists under no role, such as a Key Achievements section, or lines the layout left unplaced. Generated materials never attach these to an employer.

title: Read how the resume's experience was understood
